messages:
Sam W: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem (missing spans + bad aggregation + ETL lag). We need concrete owners and timelines for remediations. Root causes: ETL job skipping partitions after a partial schema change, and aggregator dedup bug when payload id is null. Key asks: owner for schema guard, backfill plan, dashboard/alert for aggregation mismatches, and a runbook to catch recurrence. cc @Maria P @Arjun K

Maria P: I'll take the schema guard. ETA end of week. Plan: add a forward-compat ingestion check + unit tests, and a CI warning for schema drift.

Arjun K: I'll own the aggregator dedup fix. Aiming for a PR by Thu. Need help reproducing edge-case where id==null and timestamps differ.

Taylor L: I can help reproduce. Will extract sample payloads and run the aggregator locally. Scheduling pairing tomorrow 10:00am PST.

Priya S: I'll build a dashboard showing span counts by service vs expected baseline and set an alert if delta >5%. Target: next Tue. Also will add a daily regression check for two weeks after deploy.

inc-bot: Created ticket INC-2468 (backfill estimation) and ENG-9412 (aggregator dedup fix).

Sam W: For backfill, we need an hours estimate and risk notes. Arjun + Taylor to pair on analysis and put estimate in INC-2468. Also, add a runbook step to pause upstream deploys if spans drop >10% during rollout.

Taylor L: Pairing confirmed — tomorrow 10am PST, 1hr. I'll also prepare a small dataset to validate the fix end-to-end.

Maria P: FYI I found a flaky ingestion test in CI that's likely related; I'll fix it in the same PR as the schema guard.

Arjun K: Noted. I'll include mitigation steps and a short description of the failure mode in the PR. PR link: <https://git.internal/redwood/eng/aggregator/pull/1287> (placeholder). Requesting review from @Sam W and @Maria P.

Sam W: Reviewing now. If green, plan to merge and roll to canary with the new smoke checks.

Taylor L: After merge I'll run canary and validate span counts. If delta >2% we rollback and open a hotfix channel.

Priya S: I'll add an automated smoke test that queries span counts post-deploy and fails the healthcheck if deviation >3%. Will wire it into deploy pipeline.

Sam W: Summary of action items (for Slack thread):
- Schema guard + CI lint: Maria P — EOW
- Aggregator dedup fix: Arjun K — Thu PR
- Repro + pairing: Taylor L + Arjun K — tomorrow 10am PST
- Dashboard + alert: Priya S — next Tue
- Backfill estimation ticket: INC-2468 — Arjun/Taylor to populate by Fri
- Runbook update (pause rule + detection): Sam W — before next deploy

Check-in: Fri 4:00pm PT to confirm status and unblock any rollout decisions. :thumbsup:

Maria P: Added note — I'll also publish a brief test matrix for forward-compat checks.

Arjun K: PR updated with test cases. Requesting quick pass from Taylor after pairing.

Taylor L: Will validate after we pair and post canary results in this thread.

Sam W: Thanks all. Let's keep this thread for status updates only.
